notes: Site is a Shopify store (thedecorkart.com), no WAF, direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (tier 1 only, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed). robots.txt has a full Disallow:/ for ClaudeBot/Google-Extended/GPTBot etc. but that only gates the Claude-in-Chrome last-resort tier per project policy; plain HTTP requests (as used here, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's own access method for this company) are unaffected. Checked: homepage main nav, mega-menu, announcement bar, 'At a Glance' homepage tabs (New Arrivals/Bestsellers/Trending Now/Luxury Picks), full collections.json listing (639 collections across 3 pages, keyword-scanned for bestseller/popular/trending/favourite terms), the site's own search-app JSON config (references a 'best-sellers' collection as its no-results fallback), and the /collections/bestsellers and /collections/best-sellers hub pages themselves for genuine sub-collection sliders. All qty values are exact counts from exhaustive /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination (limit=250) deduped by product id -- collections.json's products_count field is confirmed inflated for every collection checked here (e.g. bestsellers claims 50 vs 47 real, kitchen-bestsellers-1 claims 86 vs 1 real) and was not used, consistent with this site's known pattern from the prior Home-Decor extraction pass. Genuine site-declared structure: /collections/bestsellers is the primary Bestsellers PLP and itself exposes 4 real per-category children via an on-page 'shop by category' collection-list slider (Decor/Kitchen/Lighting/Wall Decor Bestsellers) -- kept as group+leaves. Trending Now (/collections/trending-now-1) is presented site-wide as a sibling top-level concept to Bestsellers (separate homepage tab, separate promo card, separate announcement-bar slide) and qualifies under the brief's 'Trending Products' target term; it has no further sub-structure of its own. A second, older Bestsellers-labeled collection (/collections/best-sellers, page H1 'The Decor Kart Bestsellers') exists and is a genuinely different product set (only 4/23 products overlap with the primary bestsellers collection) -- kept as a separate row per the multiple-PLPs rule, flagged because it is not reachable via any live navigation path, only via the search app's empty-results fallback config. Excluded as orphaned/undeclared (present in collections.json but not linked from any nav, mega-menu, or hub-page slider found): 'Best Selling Products Decor + Kitchen' (best-selling-products-decor-kitchen), 'Trending Products' (trending-products, and also a same-named but non-linking mega-menu product-showcase widget with no href of its own), 'Trending this week' (trending-this-week).
